mapper.insert: INSERT INTO enterprise_analysis_data ( period_id, enterprise_id, report_id, region, region_code, industry, industry_code, nature, nature_code, construction_employed, employed_count, unemployed_count, unemployment_rate, created_time, updated_time ) SELECT eri.period_id, eri.enterprise_id, eri.report_id, ei.region, ei.region_code, ei.industry, ei.industry_code, ei.nature, ei.nature_code, ri.construction_count, ri.investigation_count, GREATEST(0, ri.construction_count - ri.investigation_count) AS unemployed_count, ROUND((ri.construction_count - ri.investigation_count) / NULLIF(ri.construction_count,0) * 100, 2) AS unemployment_rate, NOW(), NOW() FROM enterprise_report_info eri JOIN enterprise_info ei ON ei.enterprise_id = eri.enterprise_id JOIN report_info ri ON ri.report_id = eri.report_id WHERE eri.enterprise_id = #{enterpriseId} AND eri.period_id = #{periodId} AND eri.report_id = #{reportId} AND eri.status IN (#{approvedStatus}, #{archivedStatus}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE report_id = VALUES(report_id), region = VALUES(region), region_code = VALUES(region_code), industry = VALUES(industry), industry_code = VALUES(industry_code), nature = VALUES(nature), nature_code = VALUES(nature_code), construction_employed = VALUES(construction_employed), employed_count = VALUES(employed_count), unemployed_count = VALUES(unemployed_count), unemployment_rate = VALUES(unemployment_rate), updated_time = NOW()
